language.note: Andorra is the only country in the world where Catalan is the sole official language

terrainDescription.zh: 位於庇里牛斯山脈東段的內陸微型國家，全境幾乎皆為高山地形，是歐洲海拔最高的首都所在地。
terrainDescription.en: A landlocked microstate in the eastern Pyrenees, almost entirely mountainous — home to the highest-elevation capital city in Europe.

plate.color: black serials embossed on white background; national coat of arms + "AND" country code on the left, "Principat d'Andorra" in blue below the serial

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Not independently documented — no Andorra-specific community meta found given its tiny size; treat as unconfirmed rather than inferred from Spain/France

historicalContext.zh: 安道爾夾於法國與西班牙之間，道路標誌設計與西班牙相近但語言改用加泰隆尼亞語，方向指標則採用獨特的瑞士721字體與白底紅框重點目的地設計；直到2025年1月才正式加入維也納道路標誌公約。
historicalContext.en: Wedged between France and Spain, Andorra's road-sign design closely follows Spain's but with Catalan replacing Spanish; directional signage uses a distinctive Swiss 721 Black Condensed typeface with important destinations highlighted in red on white. It only formally acceded to the Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals in January 2025.
